function.name: create_product
function.description: Create a new product with a default variant and its manual Commerce category relations. Required fields: title, seoName, price, inventory, categoryIds. AI storefront seed data should also include featuredImage. Pass categoryIds=[] only when the product is intentionally uncategorized.

seoName.description: Required nonempty SEO name used to identify the product in storefront URLs.

price.description: Required finite JSON number greater than or equal to 0. Do not send a numeric string, NaN or Infinity.

inventory.description: Required integer stock quantity from 0 to 2147483647.

categoryIds.description: Required manual Commerce category IDs returned by create_product_category. Pass an empty array only when the product is intentionally uncategorized.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
